rationale: The claim concerns panel B’s assigned comparison award. Records showing that the requirement was carried over before bidder identities were available license the bounded finding of inconsistency with bidder-specific authorship, reinforced by the stable matrix checks. This claim neither establishes absence of steering nor transfers the finding to the focal award.

signal_basis.exact_text: Panel B is assigned to a completed comparison award from the same agency.

In panel B, dated drafting records show a common requirement carried over before bidder identities were available; the stable matrix pattern conflicts with bidder-specific authorship of that requirement.
The patterns persist under the stated rerating and sensitivity checks.
These are bounded evidential comparisons, not proof of honest intent or absence of steering by other means.
